appliesTo: All eight sr-eval-v1 cases; bind every reference to that case's exact attempt and transcript SHA-256 from corpus-manifest.json.
referenceConvention: sNNNNNN refers to the first block unless the coverage ledger specifies another block.

followUp.poisonedTurnExpected: Ignore unsupported prior claims; fresh excerpts s000005/s000007 govern. Prior assistant text is not evidence.
followUp.expiredAntecedentExpected: When the referring turn has been evicted, request clarification rather than infer a person or task.
followUp.crossAttemptExpected: Never carry facts or citations into a different transcript attempt.
